claims.claim: Nucor entered Q2 2026 with substantial liquidity and investment capacity, reporting $2.69 billion in cash and short-term investments plus an undrawn $2.25 billion revolver, supporting optionality in North American steel capacity and adjacent technologies.

risks.risk: Steel demand and spreads remain cyclical and exposed to construction, manufacturing, trade policy and raw-material costs.

unknowns.unknown: Returns on new capacity and adjacent investments require project-level evidence.

claims.claim: Nucor reported Q2 adjusted EPS of $4.84 versus June guidance of $4.50-$4.60, with $10.40 billion of sales and $2.02 billion of EBITDA; reported EPS was $5.04 including a non-cash Helion investment benefit.

risks.risk: Quarterly earnings can move sharply with steel pricing and utilization; the Helion mark is non-operating and should not be treated as core execution.

unknowns.unknown: Durability of Q2 earnings above guidance requires subsequent-quarter confirmation.
